R is a one-Session retired line (no provenance, `tests/helpers/S2C-X-scale-fixture.ts:256,298`), so `readWrittenAnchors` spends exactly one unit on its first anchor page (`work-line-reader.ts:1894,1938`), then the mailbox's source read at `mailbox-service.ts:3242` spends the second (`readMany`, `plan-readers.ts:361`). With budget 2 the continuation lookup at `mailbox-service.ts:3254` is rejected `history_budget` (`work-line-reader.ts:119-121`), so `continuationRead.status !== 'ready'` at `mailbox-service.ts:3262` is taken and the part is reported partial (`work-line-reader.ts:2079-2087`). A real backend failure is a second route but does not make the arm fault-only.

Codex's route needs a direct call to the unpublished port, which no route (`src/app/core-routes.ts:404-420`) or Host code makes, so the state cannot arise: D2, not G. Codex's cited `mailbox-service.ts:1781`/`:1800` are the fact reader and the `consultationBindingOf` call itself, not a caller.
